name: tagus-of-salestax
description: Tagus of Sales Tax: tax charged on material invoices against the rates you supply for each job's jurisdiction: tax not charged (use tax to accrue), tax charged at another jurisdiction's rate, tax overcharged, tax charged on jobs you mark exempt, and deliveries to a different jurisdiction than the job. Drafts refund requests to vendors. Never files a return or posts an entry; not tax advice.
